part2.question: Describe a change that you made recently

segments.v: I want to talk about a change I made recently. I stopped going to many extra classes. Last year I went to extra classes three or four evenings a week. I came home very late and I was very tired. My grades didn't improve much because the classes were very big. So this year I decided to change. I talked with my parents. At first they didn't agree but I made a plan. I kept one maths class and I studied by myself on other evenings. I also made a study group with my friends at the library on Saturday. Now I sleep more and I feel better. My grades are the same, and my chemistry grade is better. I feel happy about this change because I can control my study.
